EN: Cloud syncing has failed. Please enable cloud saving on your device to ensure your SEASON PASS can be restored.
ZH: 云同步失败。请在您的设备上启用云存档，以确保您的赛季通行证得以恢复。

EN: One of your Dwellers has been out in the Wasteland for a short while. Perhaps you should check on them.
ZH: 您的一位居民在废土上探索了一会了，也许您应该看看他们怎么样了。

EN: One of your Dwellers has been out in the Wasteland for a quite a while, you should definitely check on them.
ZH: 您的一位居民在废土上探索有一段时间了，您真应该看看他们怎么样了。

EN: Contains 1000 Nuka-Cola Quantum which can be used to speed things up in the Vault and the Wasteland.
ZH: 包含了1000瓶量子核子可乐，可以加速避难所和废土上的事件进程。

EN: Replica of Elvis' Jailhouse Rock outfit from before the Fall. Worn by the New Vegas gang, The Kings.
ZH: 末日前猫王《监狱摇滚》演出服的复制品，曾由新维加斯帮派“猫王帮”穿着。

EN: Don't look for whoever is in this get up to clutch their pearls. Chances are they're already holding a rifle.
ZH: 别指望穿着这身行头的人会大惊小怪，十有八九他们手里已经端着步枪了。

EN: To ensure your experience is as enjoyable and hassle-free as possible, Vault-Tec engineers have implemented some exciting new features!
ZH: 为了在给您带来愉悦体验的同时让您尽量免受打扰，避难所科技的工程师们带来了令人激动的新特性！

EN: PETS HAVE COME TO FALLOUT SHELTER\nHere's a free Pet Carrier to get you started!\nOpen it to welcome a furry* friend to your Vault.
ZH: 宠物已经来到了辐射避难所。\n这有一个免费的宠物笼子，您可以从这里开始！\n打开它，欢迎一个毛茸茸*的小伙伴加入避难所吧！

EN: HERE'S A PET CARRIER TO GET YOUR PET COLLECTION STARTED! OPEN IT TO WELCOME A FURRY* FRIEND TO YOUR VAULT.
ZH: 这里有一个宠物笼子来开始您的宠物收集之旅！打开它，欢迎一个毛茸茸*的小伙伴加入避难所吧！

EN: Great! You created a new Vault. Your main objective is to keep your Dwellers alive and happy. Good luck!
ZH: 太棒了！您创建了一个新的避难所。您的工作就是让您的居民活着而且幸福。祝您好运！

EN: Now you have to determine the ID of your Vault. Choose carefully, because once you select an ID, it can't be changed!
ZH: 现在需要决定您的避难所ID号。请仔细选择，因为一旦选择，就无法改变。

EN:
[212F21]What Information May Be Collected[365136]
• Registration and Profile Information (e.g., contact and login information)
• Information from Third Party Accounts like Steam, Twitch and Facebook (e.g., friends and public profile information) 
• Payment Information (e.g., purchase history) 
• Technical (e.g., device ID, IP address, and ad tags) 
• Demographics (e.g., country and age) 
• Usage Information (e.g., in-game messages, stats, and usage data)
ZH:
[212F21]哪些信息可能被收集[365136]
• 注册和个人资料信息（例如，联系方式和登录信息）
• 来自Steam、Twitch和Facebook等第三方账户的信息（如好友和公众资料信息）
• 支付信息（例如，购买历史）
• 技术（如设备ID、IP地址和广告标签）
• 人口统计（如国家和年龄）
• 使用信息（例如，统计数据和使用数据）

EN: [365136]• Third Party Ad Companies, such as AppsFlyer, DoubleClick, King, MessageGears, Meta, [u]Unity[/u], and X
ZH: [365136]• 第三方广告公司，如 AppsFlyer、DoubleClick、King、MessageGears、Meta、[u]Unity[/u] 和 X

EN:
[212F21]With Whom It's Shared[365136]
• Service Providers and Processors, such as CloudFront 
• ZeniMax Affiliates and Subsidiaries 
• Third-Party Partners, such as Apple and Google
ZH:
[212F21]与谁共享[365136]
• 服务提供商和处理器，如 CloudFront
• ZeniMax 关联公司及子公司
• 第三方合作伙伴，如 Apple 和 Google

EN:
[212F21]Why It's Collected[365136]
• For the performance of our agreements with you (e.g., run contests, in-app purchases, improve gameplay, etc.) 
• For our legitimate commercial interests (e.g., analytics, improve gameplay, facilitate updates, send or display targeted marketing, provide tailored services and support, etc.)
ZH: [212F21]为什么收集[365136]\n• 为了履行我们与您订立的协议（例如举办竞赛、应用内购买、改进游戏体验等）\n• 为了我们的合法商业利益（例如数据分析、改进游戏体验、推送更新、发送或展示定向营销、提供定制服务与支持等）

EN: One of your Wasteland explorers has heard a cry for help that's coming from a Red Rocket fuel station. Time to rush to the rescue!
ZH: 一名废土探险者听到了一声呼救，是从红火箭服务站传来的。赶紧前去救援吧！

EN: A ghastly Glowing One has taken up residence a little too close to the Vault, and it's drawing in Ghouls like moths to a flame. Extinguish the brilliant beacon before this Ghoulish gathering grows any larger!
ZH: 可怕的发光种占领了一处居所，离避难所很近。其他的尸鬼像飞蛾扑火般地朝他涌了过来。趁着尸鬼团伙还没有扩张太快的时候，赶紧干掉这个恐怖的绿光“灯塔”！

EN: The big day is almost upon us. The idea was to have a wedding in a natural setting, but since it's too dangerous outside we'll use a nearby cave instead. We just need to sterilize it.
ZH: 激动人心的日子就要到来了。我们的想法是在自然的背景下举行一场婚礼，但外面太危险了，我们改用附近的一处洞穴，只需简单清理消毒一下就行。

EN: The Overseer of 404 appears to have a way to get in contact with the publisher of the New Boston Bugle. She's our ticket to stardom!
ZH: 404号避难所的监督者似乎有办法和新波士顿号角报的发行者取得联系。她是我们成为明星的希望！

EN: One of your dwellers has come across a relatively untouched Red Rocket. Maybe there's some valuable junk inside!
ZH: 一个你们的居民遇见了个几乎未动过的红火箭。也许里面有些值钱的东西！

EN: There's a new Vault in the Wasteland, and it's run by Raiders! Vault-Tec is long gone, so who could have possibly constructed Vault R41D? Time to investigate...
ZH: 在废土上有一个新避难所，是掠夺者管理的！避难所科技早已不复存在，那又会是谁修建了 R41D 号避难所呢？赶紧去调查吧。

EN: Raiders captured and attempted to domesticate a Deathclaw. It did not go well. They all need to die.
ZH: 掠夺者们抓住了一只死爪，试图驯服它，但并不成功。他们都得死。

EN: To thank you for saving us, we'll visit your Vault once in a while and bring your Dwellers a little bit of Nuka-fun.
ZH: 为了报答你救了我们，我们会偶尔拜访你的避难所，给你的居民们带一些核子可乐。

EN: A stranger at the RobCo Building told me the Raiders took Bottle & Cappy to the Nuka-Cola Factory. I have a feeling I'll finally catch up to them this time.
ZH: 罗伯科大楼里的一个陌生人告诉我，掠夺者把瓶瓶和盖盖带去了核子可乐工厂。我有种预感，这次终于能追上它们了。

EN: There's a bunch of supplies in the Manager's Office if you haven't found it yet. Might be something useful.
ZH: 经理办公室里有很多物资，可以找找看，说不定有些能用。

EN: Minuteman Preston Garvey has gotten himself stuck in the Kendall Hospital surrounded by Feral Ghouls and who knows what else. Save him!
ZH: 义勇军民兵普雷斯顿·加维被困在肯德尔医院了，医院被狂尸鬼和不知道是什么的可怕东西包围了，快救他！

EN: Last night, we ended up partying with Raiders at an old Warehouse. We should search there for clues to Jack's whereabouts. He's the Overseer's son, after all. If we lose him, we'll end up getting kicked out of the Vault with nothing on our backs... or worse!
ZH: 昨晚，我们在旧仓库和掠夺者们一起开了个派对。我们应该搜索那边，找到关于杰克去向的线索。毕竟他是监督者的儿子。如果我们弄丢了他，就会被赶出避难所、落得一无所有……甚至更惨！

EN: Paula Plumbkin wasn't at Vault 730, but a helpful Raider told you she set out for the old Nuka-Cola plant. Go track her down!
ZH: 宝拉·普朗布金不在730号避难所，但一个掠夺者告诉你她出发去核子可乐工厂了。快去找她吧！

EN: We have word that a fierce Alpha Deathclaw has taken up residence in an old office building. Maybe it killed Coach! Dare to dream, right?
ZH: 据说一只凶猛的领头死爪占领了一幢旧的办公楼。也许它杀了教练！它还真的做得出来！

EN: Okay, maybe 77 is an exaggeration, but there are a lot of them, and only one of you. Have you got what it takes?
ZH: 好吧，也许77太夸张了，但他们那么多人，而你就一个。你有那么大本事吗？

EN: Time to go after something a little smarter: Feral Ghouls! And speaking of smart, you'll have to do it wearing lab coats!
ZH: 是时候去对付更聪明的目标了：狂尸鬼！说到聪明——你还得穿着实验服去干！

EN: According to the crash site logs, Uncle Sam let RobCo have "the object" they were always gabbing about.
ZH: 根据坠毁现场的日志，政府把“那个东西”交给了罗伯科公司。

EN: Yeah! There's something about a "government contract" at the "R&D lab." I think there are coordinates!
ZH: 太棒了！这里面提到什么“政府合同”和“研发实验室”，应该有相应的坐标！

EN: Cmoon! I can help your vault. And it's so BORING here... Go get what you came for! I'll help haul it back!
ZH: 拜托！我可以给你们的避难所提供帮助。这儿实在太无聊了……快去拿你们要的东西！我帮你们搬回去！

EN: Oh Thanks! I'll meet you outside when you're done. I can't wait to talk to people who can talk back!
ZH: 哦，谢谢！我在外面等你们干完。我等不及要和能说话的人聊聊了！

EN: The anniversary of our first entering the Vault is approaching and it is a good opportunity to improve Vault morale by throwing a celebration! We've got food, we've got music, but it seems when VaulTec stocked our initial supplies, they forgot to include party decorations! We are going to have to send a team to the nearby Super Duper Mart to find some...
ZH: 进入避难所的周年纪念即将到来，让我们举办庆祝活动，提振避难所士气吧！虽然食物和音乐都不缺，但似乎避难所科技在储备物资时，忽视了派对装饰！我们得派人去附近的大无敌超市找一些回来……

EN: We didn't find any party supplies at the Super Duper Mart, but our team discovered that a large number of streamers and balloons had been purchased by a government employee shortly before the bombs fell. We have traced the employee to a nearby government building. We are going to send a team to the facility to find and retrieve the missing party supplies.
ZH: 虽然在大无敌超市没找到任何派对用品，但我们的队伍发现，有位政府人员在炸弹落下前不久大量购买了彩带和气球。我们追踪到这位官员的下落，发现他在附近的一座政府大楼里。我们得派人去那儿找回那些派对用品。

EN: While looking for decorations, our team discovered something at the old government building that was a surprise to us all. We have since sifted through the data in all of our logs and found reference to a government facility that may hold more revelatory information. This may lead us to some tech that could help us improve the Vault leaps and bounds beyond what was planned. We need to send out a team as soon as possible!
ZH: 在寻找装饰品的过程中，我们在那座旧政府大楼里发现了让我们大吃一惊的东西。我们查阅了所有日志，发现其中提到了一处可能藏有更多秘密信息的政府设施。我们有可能可以找到一些科技帮助我们大幅提升避难所的实力。我们需要尽快派队伍出发！

EN: We stumbled on something unbelievable at the government facility. When we took a further look into the research data, we found records of a field research lab at a so-called "crash site" where they were conducting experiments on "the object." Let's get to this crash site and see what we can scavenge!
ZH: 我们在政府设施里碰到了一些难以置信的东西。当我们深入研究那些数据时，发现有记录提到一处“坠毁现场”，那里有个实地研究实验室，曾进行着关于“某个物体”的实验。快去这处坠毁现场，看看我们能捡到什么好东西！

EN: We've been churning through the data that came back from that UFO lab we scouted a while back. Turns out, the old government turned over most of their specimens to RobCo. We found a holotape among the junk you brought back from the UFO Crash Site mentioning something about the next step in the development of advanced AI. Luckily, the nearest RobCo factory is pretty close to our vault. Let's send some dwellers there and see if we can find that research data. It could make a big difference for our vault!
ZH: 我们一直在分析从外星飞船实验室带回来的数据。结果发现，旧政府把大部分样本都交给了罗伯科公司。我们从你带回来的飞船坠毁现场垃圾里找到了一张磁带，上面提到下个阶段的先进人工智能开发。幸运的是，我们避难所附近就有一个罗伯科公司的工厂。快派些居民去那里，看看能不能找到那份研究数据，这对我们的避难所将大有帮助！

EN: We cracked the executive's logs from the RobCo factory and discovered the location of a secret RobCo R&D facility. It occupies a series of secret levels below a retail store at the local mall. RobCo was using alien technology to advance their robotics research. They were trying to build something big. If we can figure out what they knew, we should be able to use it to make major improvements to the Vault!
ZH: 我们破解了罗伯科公司工厂高管的日志，发现了一处秘密的研发设施。它就藏在当地商场的一家零售店地下，罗伯科公司竟然在利用外星科技推进他们的机器人研究。他们试图打造一些大玩意儿。如果我们能搞清楚他们知道些什么，就能对避难所进行大幅改进！

EN: Our new chef has some bold ideas to spruce up our daily fare, and he's made a list of specific ingredients he needs. We should visit a nearby abandoned Super-Duper Mart to see if we can find any of them.
ZH: 我们的新厨师有一些大胆的想法来改善我们的日常饮食，他列出了所需要的具体食材。我们应该去附近一个废弃的大无敌超市看看能不能找到。

EN: Rubarb has found another Vault to liberate. Time to head out and rescue Overseer Chang from the Raiders!
ZH: 鲁巴布又发现了一个要解放的避难所。是时候出发然后从掠夺者手中救出监督者阿昌了。

EN: We've received word that a nearby Vault is holding a Singles Night for Valentine's Day, and they've invited us to participate!
ZH: 我们收到消息，附近的一个避难所正在为情人节举行单身之夜的活动，他们邀请了我们同去！

EN: You came across an old cabin while adventuring in the Wasteland. Perhaps you should see what's inside.
ZH: 当你在废土探险的时候发现了一个小屋。也许你该看看里面有什么。

EN: The only way we can get more information about the Water Wizard is to clear out this Raider camp. Should be a walk in the park!
ZH: 我们能获得更多关于水之术士的信息的唯一方法就是清除这个掠夺者营地。应该像在公园里散步一样容易！

EN: The gunsmith's plea came in loud and clear over the radio. “Feral Ghouls! Help! I'll give one of my best pieces to whoever bails me out!” Better hurry if you're going to claim that prize!
ZH: 枪匠的呼喊从广播里传来，声音大而清楚。“狂尸鬼！救命！谁要是能救我出去我会拿最好的武器报答他！”如果你想要这个奖励的话得赶快了。

EN: Go, then. It should be clear past here. We'll hold this point. Oh! We found this. You might be able to use it for your vault.
ZH: 去吧。那边应该没什么人了。我们会守在这里的。对了，我们找到了这个，你们避难所可能用得上。

EN: The Brotherhood is attacking the Griffith Observatory to recover a deadly weapon from the NCR. We don't know what it is, but it could be disastrous in anybody's hands. Go, take care of it for everyone's sake.
ZH: 兄弟会正在攻击格里菲斯天文台，企图从新加州共和国手中夺回一种致命武器。虽然不知道具体是什么武器，但无论落入任何一方手中，都可能产生灾难性后果。为了保护所有人的安全，快去把它处理掉。

EN: Three down, one to go, and thanks to Three Dog, we know where Death's cave is. But will he be awake? Only one way to find out!
ZH: 搞定了三个，还剩一个，感谢三狗让我们知道了“死亡”的洞穴在哪。但是它会醒过来吗？只有一个办法知道。

EN: We found a note from someone named Coach, who claims he has Rackie Jobinson's Jersey! Maybe he's hiding out in the ruins of Vault 428...
ZH: 我们发现了一个叫教练的人留下的消息，他说自己有罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫！也许他藏在了428号避难所的废墟里……

EN: Assuming Coach doesn't have the Jersey, there's reason to believe Rackie Jobinson once stayed at the old Le Pierre Hotel. We'll check there!
ZH: 假如教练没有棒球衫，我们有理由相信罗基·杰宾森曾待在旧的乐皮埃尔酒店。我们去那边看看吧！

EN: A reporter for the Weekly Exposition newspaper, undercover as a Pest, told us about Pestilence and asked us to relay a message to his editor. He also said there are reporters hidden among the Hungry and the Warshippers, so let's go to the Exposition's offices and find out what they know!
ZH: 《每周博览会报》的一名记者，正以“害虫”的身份做卧底，他把“瘟疫”的事告诉了我们，并请我们给编辑转达一条消息。他还说，有些记者藏在“饥饿者”和“战争崇拜者”中间，所以我们去博览会办公室，看看他们知道些什么！

EN: He was the most qualified, obviously. What's that, Overseer? You want to go with them? I suppose I could run things while you're gone...
ZH: 他显然最有资格。监督者你怎么了？你想和他们一起去？你不在我应该也行的……

EN: Wait! I think our Overseer wants to go with you. He says it'll help diplomatic relations between our two Vaults.
ZH: 等等！我想我们的监督者想和你一起去。他说这有利于两个避难所的外交关系。

EN: No, I'm not! Tell them I'm not crazy, Overseer! What's that? Oh, you want to go with them? I guess that would be all right...
ZH: 不，我不是！监督者，告诉他们我没有疯！那是什么？哦，你想和他们一起去？我想应该可以……

EN: The Overseer from Vault 850 has sent us a distress signal! The catch is the Overseer is apparently a dog...
ZH: 850号避难所的监督者给我们发来了求救信号！关键问题在于：这位监督者貌似是一只狗……

EN: Clever Alpha Deathclaw, hiding in that Red Rocket Fuel station to ambush unsuspecting travelers. There's only one way to deal with a threat like that.
ZH: 聪明的领头死爪，藏在了红火箭加油站里伏击误入的旅行者。对付这种威胁只有一个办法。

EN: It's New Year's day... and the Vault threw one heck of a party last night. But the Overseer's son, Jack, is missing and we need to find him! We know he was with us before the clock struck 12, but everything afterwards is a blur. And we're all wearing Radiation Suits. We must have been at the Corvega Auto Plant at some point...
ZH: 新年第一天……昨夜避难所举行了隆重的派对活动。但是监督者的儿子杰克失踪了。我们必须找到他！现在只知道12点之前他还和我们在一起，但之后发生了什么完全是一片模糊，我们都穿着防辐射服，所以我们应该是去过可伟佳自动化工厂……

EN: No? Because it says right here on the masthead that the New Boston Bugle is published out of the Nuka-Cola Warehouse.
ZH: 学不乖又怎样？这里说得清清楚楚新波士顿号角就是从核子可乐仓库里发行出来的。
